inputs.text: [serious] He was a herbivore, [calm] and maybe a few insects. He lived in groups. [hesitant] Big carnivores hunted him, but his hard head could put up a fight.
[curious] Did he fight with his head?
[playful] That's what scientists think. [curious] The males may have charged head-first at each other, like rams do today. [hesitant] But we're not totally sure.
